units.source_text: 芍药也种了一片，足有十坪之多，由于还没到季节，一株开花的也没有。

en.t: Peonies had also been planted over a patch of more than ten tsubo, but since their season had not yet come, not a single plant was in bloom.

units.source_text: 在这片芍药田旁有个旧缘台似的台子，先生伸开四肢，躺在上面，我坐在边角上，抽了一支烟。

en.t: Beside this peony bed was something like an old garden bench; Sensei stretched out his arms and legs and lay down on it, while I sat at one corner and smoked a cigarette.

units.source_text: 先生望着蔚蓝通透的天空，我被周围碧绿的嫩叶吸引住了。

en.t: Sensei gazed up at the clear blue sky, while I was captivated by the vivid green young leaves around us.

units.source_text: 细细观瞧，发现那些嫩叶的绿色没有相同的，即便是同样的枫树，每个树枝上的叶子也没有一样颜色的。

en.t: Looking closely, I saw that no two shades of green among those young leaves were the same; even on the same maple tree, the leaves on each branch differed in color.

units.source_text: 先生挂在细杉树苗树梢上的帽子被一阵风刮到了地上。

en.t: A gust of wind blew Sensei's hat, which had been hung on the tip of a slender cedar sapling, down to the ground.
2. Tsubo: a unit of land area; one tsubo equals 3.306 square meters.

units.source_text: 3.缘台：木制或竹制的长方形坐台，放置于庭院等处用于纳凉等。

en.t: 3. Endai: a rectangular wooden or bamboo bench placed in a garden or similar spot, used for cooling off and relaxing.
